# shoal_federation_link (Resource)

Federates a tenant: its data lives in a member deployment that the hub reaches through the member's tenant connector. Operator only (the provider's `api_key` must be the admin token or a key with `system:admin`). Give `enrollment_token` to the member's admin for `shoal federation join`. Destroying the resource revokes the link; the member keeps running on its own. Maps to `/v1/federation/links/{tenant}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Run with the operator's credentials (the admin token or a key with system:admin).
variable "operator_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

provider "shoal" {
  alias   = "operator"
  api_key = var.operator_token
}

# Globex runs Shoal in its own org; the hub reaches it through Globex's tenant connector.
resource "shoal_federation_link" "globex" {
  provider = shoal.operator
  tenant   = "globex" # an empty tenant on the hub
  mode     = "read_write"
}

# Hand this to Globex's admin: shoal federation join <hub-url> <token> ...
output "globex_enrollment_token" {
  value     = shoal_federation_link.globex.enrollment_token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tenant` (String) Slug of the tenant to federate. It must be empty: its data lives in the member deployment.

### Optional

- `mode` (String) Access the hub asks for: `read` or `read_write` (default). The member's ceiling can lower it; see `effective_mode`.

### Read-Only

- `connected` (Boolean) Whether the member's connector polled recently.
- `effective_mode` (String) The lower of `mode` and `member_mode`; `read` until the member enrolls.
- `enrollment_expires_at` (String) When `enrollment_token` expires.
- `enrollment_token` (String, Sensitive) One-time enrollment token, set on create. Replace the resource to issue a new one.
- `id` (String) Link ID (`fed_...`).
- `last_seen_at` (String) When the member's connector last polled.
- `member_mode` (String) The member's ceiling, once enrolled.
- `namespaces` (List of String) Namespaces the member exposes (empty: all).
- `status` (String) `pending` (waiting for enrollment) or `active`.
- `visibility` (String) `full`, or `metadata` when the member hides run data.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The tenant slug. The enrollment token is not returned by the API, so it is empty after import.
terraform import shoal_federation_link.globex globex
```
